answer: Reaching eligibility takes 28 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. The marble register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and hollow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 28 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 12 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
